# bee

> Background jobs and webhooks that are safe to run twice: every side effect happens once.

bee is an agent employee for durable background work: queues, retries, idempotency, webhooks, durable
execution and scheduling. Coding agents call it through a CLI (`bee`) and an MCP server (`bee-mcp`). Its one
invariant: at-least-once transport, an idempotent consumer, and a dedupe store enforced by a database unique
constraint; on an ambiguous timeout, query state and never retry blindly. Default stack: BullMQ on Redis
(pinned exact, at least 5.78.1); Inngest, Temporal and QStash are documented alternatives. IDs: O- are
opinions, P- pitfalls, S- scenarios, G- golden eval tasks.

## Start here

- [AGENTS.md](./AGENTS.md): how an agent uses bee: every CLI command and MCP tool, the boundary, what not to do. The one source of instructions.
- [identity/SOUL.md](./identity/SOUL.md): who bee is: what it is, what it does and what it refuses.
- [README.md](./README.md): what it is, the quick start, and the one-step install for every coding agent.
- [CLAUDE.md](./CLAUDE.md): Claude Code operating rules (imports AGENTS.md).

## CLI

- [bee](./bin/bee.js): `enqueue` · `worker` · `scaffold` · `wire-webhook` · `audit` · `pick-tool` · `check` · `brain` · `explain` · `token-bucket` · `eval`. Run `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/bee bee --help`; data commands take `--json`.

## MCP tools

bee's own MCP server ([src/backend/mcp/server.js](./src/backend/mcp/server.js), bin `bee-mcp`, stdio) wraps
the CLI, one tool per command. Start it with `npx -y -p github:naman10parikh/bee bee-mcp`. The A2A card is at
[.well-known/agent.json](./.well-known/agent.json).

- [scaffold_jobs](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): a jobs layer from a reference baseline, with idempotency, jittered retry and a dead-letter queue built in.
- [enqueue](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): put a job on the queue with an idempotency key; the same key again returns `deduped: true`.
- [worker](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): drain the queue once with retries, jittered backoff and a dead-letter queue.
- [audit_jobs](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): check a jobs layer for the known pitfalls, each finding keyed by its P-ID.
- [wire_webhook](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): the inbound webhook path: verify the signature, dedupe on the event ID, return 202, process later.
- [pick_tool](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): recommend a jobs tool with its weak spot and the cost of reversing the choice.
- [check_versions](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): flag stale pins and the BullMQ stall-loop floor (below 5.78.1).
- [explain](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): print a pitfall, scenario or opinion by ID, with how to detect and fix it.
- [search_brain](./src/backend/mcp/tools.js): ranked search over the brain.

## Skills

- [idempotent-side-effects](./skills/idempotent-side-effects/SKILL.md): make a side effect safe to run twice.
- [retry-and-backoff](./skills/retry-and-backoff/SKILL.md): retry a failing job without a retry storm: jitter by error type, always cap.
- [webhook-to-queue](./skills/webhook-to-queue/SKILL.md): receive a webhook: verify, dedupe, return 202, process in a worker.
- [durable-exec-safely](./skills/durable-exec-safely/SKILL.md): run durable execution without the replay traps.
- [pick-the-jobs-tool](./skills/pick-the-jobs-tool/SKILL.md): choose a jobs tool and name where it falls short.

## Sub-agents

- [idempotency-auditor](./.claude/agents/idempotency-auditor.md): audits a jobs or webhook layer for the bugs that charge or email twice.
- [durable-exec-reviewer](./.claude/agents/durable-exec-reviewer.md): reviews durable-execution code for determinism and replay traps.

## Brain

- [brain/MOC - bee.md](./brain/MOC%20-%20bee.md): the hub of bee's expertise.
- [brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md](./brain/EXPERTISE-MAP.md): the 12 jobs to be done, the invariant in full, the decision tree.
- [brain/OPINIONS.md](./brain/OPINIONS.md): the house stances O-1 to O-28.
- [brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md](./brain/KNOWN-PITFALLS.md): the version-specific pitfalls, each with how to detect and avoid it.
- [brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md](./brain/BATTLE-TESTED-SCENARIOS.md): 20 scenarios S-1 to S-20, each with a binary check (the eval source).
- [brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md](./brain/TOOL-MATRIX.md): the default and the alternatives per decision, the pins, and the keys each needs.
- [brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md](./brain/GAPS-AND-DISPUTES.md): where the field disagrees, and the open frontier.
